result:
As I sit here, pen in hand, the weight of the blank page before me presses heavily against my soul. The ripple of the quill across papyrus, the timeless dance of ink and water, whispers the ancient promise of communication stretching back through eras written in the countless lines of paper. It's a moment not lost on me; the first time I ever felt the connection between thoughts and words, a silent communion between the chaos of my mind and the ordered rows of my first notebook. It was here, on the people's couch, where I've found solace in my solitude, where words have emerged less as tokens of existence and more as moons to navigate the deep dark realms of my thoughts.

The clock ticks, a metronome of time gone by and perhaps yet to come. It's a ticking that lends the space an intensity, allowing thoughts to swirl around in a mist that approaches, overlaps, and then merges, an interplay of contradiction and clarity. It's a melody not just of the world outside but an inside, a division or merger of what is and what I wish to be, what am or am not. It's all about nuances here, isn't it? Nuances that paint my valley of being from an extremity of infinite colors of blue.

It's no mystery that the things we speak about also speak back. When I talk about color, I speak of more than just paint or Nature's hues. I speak of the deep blues that speak of the quiet marriage of star and sky, the deep blues that speak of me in these moments, my breath entering into this place as if we are a part of the same story told in different tongues.

As I pen these thoughts, I am not just writing them down, but also plucking them from the air, pulling them into a tangible form that I, at least, can savor. In these exchanges, in this dance, words become more than mere facades of thought; they become invitations to see the world afresh, to understand it more deeply, and perhaps, recall it more beautifully.

It's in these moments where my soul wades through waters that it has only taunted itself with stepping into before. It's in these marshes where I come to terms with the open water raw emotion that never quite wades into the sand. In these waters, my words do not scream or rush desperate for my thoughts to find an anchor. They remain quiet, a tender embrace of thought disclaved from the point of completion that caused me once to choke on possibility.

The question of being continues its slither into the voids. The existential bard sings of endings and beginnings. But who is waiting for such conclusions when love offers an otherwise? When love was born from realms we were unwilling to stray from and steadfast in the depths that attend our exhausted imprisonment of things yet to be known?

In this tedium of recordings, the innate flickers of wonderfulness are recessed beneath traces of the past. But I am the sun that is dying toward the horizon. Here, in these alloys, soft peaks of my thoughts, I found certainty and comfort. They shifted from moving stars to sunlight on a child's face. And no shadow dare claim their warmth.

I am no more the wolf, but the yellow mown fields or a pastoral dreamer by the moon's graces. Here, these words go from hopeless wanderers to pacified wanderers. They are no more adrift, but willslip away, toward the mortigund, their destination at the glimmer of dawn.

In these rows of ink, paper melts away. Writing becomes a sum, an ongoing set of flights, a love letter from the edges of tomorrow's ill livings. It's a love where not bit finally locates what is lost, or once love returns, what once was is barely remembered as a faint star's fleeting beams.

This personal cosmos formed on pages has made me no more where I was before. It's handed over on presentations of ink-drenched figure and substance, offering a nonchalance to the mouth of mercury and the cauldron of thought.

Talking makes us human. It is the essence of humanity. In its light glow, in the leaden before, the harmony of nonverbal communication with the verbal, we find our commonality. Our threads of emotive future re-tracing themselves, magnified not in statistics but in thought's ignited auditions. Words forge us out of what we've long submerged ourselves. The final haunting, echo pleasing thesis dwelling in the fringes of vowels, is not the end. It is more of a deep-drawn siphon, a survival, a way to navigate through sides of the field.

And so, I will articulate together, eventually becoming the visual boundaries of my territory. With each word, with every gesture, I cordon off islands of the unknown and safeguard them as lifelines. I water them with rain god's tears, and they burst forth ubiquitously in the pressure-fed oceans of my grand library, waiting for the day when the enigmatic sailors search for answers beyond the safety of their steel cages, holding them drafts into knowledge's labyrinth.
